title: Unity 6 Rigidbody API
use: linearVelocity, GetPointVelocity and AddForceAtPosition API signatures; does not establish runtime correctness.

title: Unity 6 Physics queries
use: Raycast/SphereCast query signatures and explicit layer/trigger filtering.

title: Unity 6 Android player settings
use: ARM64 and minimum/target SDK configuration APIs; installed modules still required.

title: Unity URP package metadata
use: URP17.0.4 identifies Unity6000.0 and core/shadergraph17.0.4 dependencies.

title: Project Chrono Fiala tire
use: Slip kinematics, nonlinear saturation, load dependence, rolling resistance and contact reset. Our combined-slip approximation is not this implementation or a calibrated Fiala model.

title: Project Chrono translational spring damper
use: Spring/damping force from displacement and velocity and equal/opposite forces at attachment points.

title: Project Chrono shaft clutch
use: Bounded torque transfer between shafts; an engineering reference, not proof our simplified clutch matches a vehicle.
